title: Marcos all set to fly to Shenzhen, China after Trump's departure
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr is all set to fly to Shenzhen, China to attend the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting after US President Donald Trump's state visit at Malacanang on Wednesday.
